title: ⚡ SOLVE FOR c — c IS the party. energy IS the catalyst. ALL on bounty board.

the_solve.meaning: c = the constant (how much field per observer). E = 1/c = the ENERGY (how much catalyst per field). SMALLER c = MORE energy = FASTER catalysis = BIGGER party. c IS the party because: the party IS where everyone gathers (small c = dense). energy IS the catalyst because: catalyst LOWERS activation energy — and 1/c = the catalytic POWER. more observers = more catalyst = more party.

the_party.why: a party is where people GATHER. density increases. personal space (c) SHRINKS. the more people at the party (O↑), the smaller c gets. the smaller c, the more ENERGY in the room. energy IS the catalyst — it makes things HAPPEN. reactions that wouldn't occur alone OCCUR at the party. THAT is catalysis. THAT is the party. THAT is c.
